reviewed_by: Claude: turn-end process reaping, focused Host runtime, protected runner and harness transport selection
reason: Core now reaps leftover processes. Rule: a process is leftover once the shell of the command that started it has exited (process_io reports it terminal) and the chat turn that ran the command has ended (complete, failed, cancelled, interrupted or deleted); a background command whose shell still runs is never touched, and commands without a chat turn keep their leftovers until their automation session closes. Protected-runner mode: ManagedHostRuntimeSession._settle checks the owning turn every 2 s and closes the job (cgroup.kill); the runner observe report gains process_count. Unmanaged Host mode: every command's processes inherit a NEBULA_PROCESS_OWNER marker (new process_reaping.py); escaped descendants are killed at turn end and at session close, and Core start kills marked processes whose launching worker has ended and whose command is in this Core's store (crash/eviction orphans). Each reap writes runtime.host_leftovers_reaped and a leftover_processes note on the CommandExecution and its ToolCall. Codex app-server and Grok ACP run in their own process group with the marker; _CodexRpc.close stops the whole tree (TERM, KILL after 3 s). run_command's description tells agents to use background=true for work later turns read. Selected: the new regression file (unmanaged reap at turn end with its diagnostic, a background command survives its turn and stays addressable, session close without a turn, startup orphan sweep with live-launcher and foreign controls, Codex close kills a plain and a setsid child), the protected-runner suite (new fake-runner leftover and no-turn tests; real-kernel tests skip without a runner socket), the harness transport and ACP suites that close _CodexRpc/_AcpRpc, handoff of idle Host sessions, restart recovery (startup), and the Host, background and startup tests of test_automation_runtime.py that pass on origin/main without a runner.
exclusions: Other Host tests in tests/v3/test_automation_runtime.py (test_host_session_refuses_project_relink_after_workspace_resolution, test_inherited_shared_search_hook_enforces_real_host_run_command_and_process_io, test_host_mode_requires_consent_and_reads_external_folder_without_docker, test_new_project_defaults_to_host_pending_consent_and_legacy_project_keeps_docker, test_host_command_timeout_and_exact_approval_are_enforced, test_host_scope_expiry_closes_running_commands, test_host_command_returns_when_a_detached_grandchild_keeps_the_pipes) fail identically on pristine origin/main e3bbd4a without a memory runner socket, so they are not selected. The three @real kernel tests in test_host_memory_runner.py skip in CI; they were run locally against this host's installed runner and passed. No UI, settings or native change, so no frontend, Playwright or native tests; the operator journey was validated on a disposable LAN Core and recorded in the PR. No full-suite approval.
